title: Liquid AI Builds On-Device Context Layer for Personal AI Agents
key_facts: Liquid AI announced Liquid Context on 23 Sep 2026 at Snapdragon Summit 2026.
It is optimised for Qualcomm Snapdragon processors and the Hexagon NPU, for phones, wearables, PCs and vehicles.
It learns routines and preferences from permitted device signals, keeps that context locally and shares it with agents the user authorises.
It pairs the memory layer with the LFM2.5-2.6B agentic model.
A multi-year Mercedes-Benz partnership was announced 23 Apr 2026, targeting first in-car deployment as early as the second half of 2026.
Liquid AI is working on observability and improvement loops so agents can 'self-heal' and personalise over time.
quote_evidence: Liquid AI announced Liquid Context Sept. 23 at Snapdragon Summit 2026.
Liquid Context is designed to learn routines, preferences and needs from permitted device signals, maintain that context locally and provide relevant information to agents authorized by the user.
The companies targeted an initial production deployment as early as the second half of 2026.
why_it_matters_hint: Private, on-device memory for AI agents, but this is an old announcement with no release date.
notes: Older news re-dated: announcement was 15 days before the 8 Oct window start; TokenPost article adds no new launch.
